title: 3D tilt and depth can be keyed and tweaked as easily as position
goal: Animating in 3D should be as quick as moving something: put the playhead somewhere, tilt or push the layer (with the canvas arcs, the panel, or typed values) and that becomes a key; move the playhead, tilt again, and there is a 3D animation. Today the user cannot set key values for the new 3D options at all.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-12): "I can't seem to set keyframe values for the new 3d options. I want to be able to easily tweak things to animate in 3d."

From code reading (not run): the 3D panel rows carry key diamonds and Add/Remove Key Here (Sources/Photonz/Space3DInspector.swift:36-87, KeyedProperty .motion(property)); MotionProperty has rotationX, rotationY, depth (PhotonzCore/LayerMotion.swift:97-102). SUSPECT, not confirmed: the canvas 3D arc drag commits to the layer's base turn3D (EditorState+Space3D.swift; in-flight preview at CanvasDisplay.swift:1135 sets $0.turn3D), not to the keyed value at the playhead, so on a keyed layer the keys win and the drag appears to do nothing. Check how 2D rotate/move resolve 'drag on a keyed layer' and use the same path. Upcoming tasks change the surfaces (transform overlay replacing the 3D section, key overlay, only-animated rows with auto-key, seq 16-20); this task fixes keying now with the current surfaces and its rule must carry into them.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults, exactly as a person would: a text layer and a recording on the timeline; try to key Rotation X, Rotation Y and Depth by (a) the 3D section's key diamonds, (b) right-click Add Key Here, (c) dragging the canvas 3D arcs with and without existing keys, (d) Animate a property; record in the audit which fail and why

With a layer that has 3D keys, dragging the canvas 3D arcs or typing a 3D value while the playhead is on a key changes THAT key's value; between keys it adds a key at the playhead (the same rule position and rotation follow, whichever that is; the audit says the rule and it is the same for every property); the change is never silently overridden by existing keys
With a layer that has no 3D keys, a key diamond click or Add Key Here on Rotation X, Rotation Y, Depth or Pivot depth adds a key with the current value, and the row and lane appear
Camera values (perspective, push, pan, focus) key the same way
The 3D values show on the key lanes and in Show Graph like any other property, with the shared curves

A walk at Next defaults keys a text layer from Rotation Y 90 at 0 s to 0 at 1 s by dragging the arc at each moment, plays it and checks mid-frames are tilted (projected quad near edge to far edge ratio above 1.1 at 0.5 s)
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
